_comment: THE ONE HOME for the AI offers: the /start page renders from this file, the Greenfire operator's Clients tab reads it, and Pip (the Fellowship workshops agent) quotes from it. Prices, what is included and the checkout links live here and nowhere else. Checkout links are filled by `node _TOOLS/operator/offers.mjs make`, never typed by hand. No em dashes anywhere: Jordan reads them as machine written.

page.headline: Learn AI, have it built for you, or build it together
page.intro: I teach people and businesses to build with AI on their own computers, so the dashboards, agents and apps they end up with are theirs and keep working for them. Three ways to work with me: I teach you and set you up, I build your whole AI environment for you, or we work side by side for three months.
page.checkout_note: Secure checkout by Stripe. The payment page and your card statement say The Great Medicine Show, which is Jordan's own business. Your receipt comes from Stripe.
page._layout_note: OFFICIAL PRICING since 2026-11-08, his decision: $5,000 Learn It (teaching and setup), $10,000 Build It (your AI environment built for you), $18,000 Build It Together (three months working together). Nothing is sold under $5,000. Only Jordan may cut a deal (a small artist or a friend); agents never offer one. The $500 class, the Boulder class, $500 one to one onboarding, the $500 Activation, the $1,500 and $2,000 builds and the $100 self-serve course are retired (private_offers, retired 2026-11-08) and their links deactivated. Kept as they were: $200 a month care, $100 a month Builder membership, the $500 kids Game Creator Lab.
page.team_note: Bringing a whole team or company? The same three packages, sized for your team after a short call. Tell me about your team in the form below.

_intake_note: Our own onboarding form (api/onboard.ts, questions in api/_lib/onboardQuestions.ts), replacing the Google Form 2026-10-20. Add ?for=<offer id> to preselect the session. Answers land on the operator Clients tab.

offers.title: Learn It: AI Teaching and Setup
offers.unit: one to one, four sessions of two hours, online or in person
offers.for: You want to learn to build with AI yourself, and have everything set up properly on your own computer while you learn.
teaches: Setting up AI on your own computer: Claude, Claude Code, your terminal, GitHub and one project folder for your business
Talking to AI in plain words so it builds, fixes and changes things for you
Building a dashboard for your business, with you at the keys
Making AI agents that research, draft and follow up, and keeping them safe so nothing sends without your yes
Connecting the tools you already use: email, calendar, payments, socials and your website
Putting a page or a small site online
includes: AI installed, signed in and working on your computer
Your own business dashboard running, with your customers, offers and week in it
Your project brief and master prompt, so AI knows your business every time you ask
Recordings of all four sessions to come back to
30 days of help by message after the last session
offers.terms: Half to start ($2,500), half at the last session.
offers.after: After you pay the $2,500 to start: pick your first session time, then fill in a short intake form.

offers.title: Build It: Your AI Environment, Built for You
offers.unit: built around your business, about four weeks
offers.for: You want your whole AI setup built for you: dashboards, agents and workflows running on your real business, and you trained to run it.
teaches: Everything in Learn It, taught around the system I build for you
How to run, change and grow your AI environment yourself
How to show your team to use it day to day
includes: A discovery call and a map of how your week really runs
Your AI command center built: one dashboard for your whole business, on your own computer
AI agents set up for your work, such as inbox, follow ups, bookings and content, each one asking before it acts
Up to five of your workflows connected to the tools you already use
Your website or landing pages built or connected, if you need them
Everything in Learn It: the setup, the teaching and the recordings
A two hour handover for you and your team
30 days of fixes after handover
offers.terms: Half to start ($5,000), half at handover. Anything beyond the five workflows is quoted before it is built. Optional care after handover is $200 a month.
offers.after: After you pay the $5,000 to start: a short intake form, and Jordan emails you within a day to book the discovery call.
